issues.title: Imp concepts of AI
issues.description:
## Overview
Deep conceptual course covering foundational and advanced concepts in modern Artificial Intelligence.

## Focus Areas
- Transformer architectures: Self-attention, multi-head attention, encoders vs decoders
- Vector embeddings, latent dimensions, and metric spaces (Cosine, Euclidean, Dot Product)
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Dense vs sparse retrieval, chunking strategies, and re-ranking
- Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT): LoRA, QLoRA, and prefix tuning
- LLM alignment, RLHF, and guardrails

Course Link - https://youtu.be/ZaPbP9DwBOE?si=bJHTpoQ5Ti0nlNX4

subtasks.title: Transformer architecture: Self-attention, encoders, decoders
Embeddings, vector spaces & cosine similarity
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) paradigms & chunking strategies
Fine-tuning methods: LoRA, QLoRA, and prompt tuning
LLM evaluation metrics: ROUGE, BLEU, G-Eval, hallucination detection

issues.title: AI Learning Path
issues.description:
## Overview
Structured learning roadmap for transitioning into an elite AI and agentic software engineer.

## Learning Path Milestones
1. Foundations: Advanced Python, linear algebra, and data science libraries
2. Deep Learning: PyTorch, model training loops, and transformer architectures
3. Modern GenAI: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
4. Production Systems: Multi-agent supervisor patterns, evaluation pipelines, and low-latency serving

subtasks.title: Foundation: Python, linear algebra & statistics for AI
Deep Learning: PyTorch neural networks & transformers
Generative AI & Agentic frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen)
Building autonomous multi-agent systems for DevOps workflows
